CYBER DEFENDER RADAR / IN DEVELOPMENT

Understand the evidence.
Choose the next step.

The product direction connects security observations, clear reports, AI explanations and human support. The public platform is not live.

Three connected capabilities

Radar

A bounded internal proof of concept collects DNS records, selected HTTPS headers and a TLS handshake from Cyber Defender-owned domains only. It is not customer monitoring or a prospect-scanning service.

Customer dashboard

Planned: verified assets, dated assessments, evidence, confidence and remediation history behind authenticated access.

AI Analyst

Planned: read-only explanations grounded in the customer’s authorised reports, with a consent-based handover to human support.

What exists today?

  • Working marketing preview and an illustrative report.
  • Internal owned-domain research code and automated parser tests.
  • Explicit completed, failed and unassessed check states.

What remains planned?

Customer login, subscriptions, recurring monitoring, AI chat, analyst handover, automated reports and remediation requests are not operational. No account can be created here and no scan can be submitted.

Discover and Protect

Discover is a proposed human-reviewed public-evidence workflow. Protect would assess only verified customer assets within written authorisation. Neither mode is offered through this page. No public questionnaire or notification grants testing permission.

Clear boundaries

Public signals are not proof of compromise. Unknown settings remain unknown; a failed check never means a passed control. Remediation would require a defined scope, quote and customer approval. Human support hours and allowances must be confirmed before sale.
